title: Evidence-tier citation schema (engage-apothecary)
description: Citation shape with mandatory evidence tier. Tier hierarchy (highest → lowest): systematic-review > rct > cohort > case-control > case-series > expert-opinion. Synthesis weights citations by tier. Unknown tiers fail validation. Fabricated quantitative likelihood ratios are forbidden; the citation shape only records the tier and the claim — quantitative LRs are reported in the differential brief's testCharacteristics field with explicit literature backing.

source.description: URL, DOI, or other unambiguous source identifier.

tier.description: Evidence tier (highest → lowest): systematic-review > rct > cohort > case-control > case-series > expert-opinion.

claim.description: What this citation supports in the context of the brief.

year.description: Publication year. Used by the recency-gate flag (does not reject; informational).

outsideRecencyWindow.description: Optional flag set by the differential brief when the citation's year is outside the --recency-years window.
